title.en: An Act Authorizing the Municipal Board of Manila to Change the Name of the Cavite Boulevard to Dewey Boulevard.

text.en:
The Municipal Board of Manila is hereby authorized to order the name of the present Cavite
Boulevard changed to Dewey Boulevard.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 20, 1921.
